title: Test plan · Week 1 · v1
sub: 3 tests, $77 test budget for the week
headline: Week 1 tests replace tired Streak creative and extend what worked at $2.4 vs $4 target.

content.summary: Week 1 tests replace tired Streak creative and extend what worked at $2.4 vs $4 target.

tests.name: Streak Refresh - Forgiving Streak
tests.hypothesis: Streak ad is tiring out with CTR down 61.7% at 7.1 frequency and $8.7 per trial vs $4 target, a forgiving-streak angle on phone may reduce fatigue and bring cost closer to target
tests.stop_rule: Run 7 days, stop if cost remains above target after min spend

brief.angle: Forgiving streak on phone - missed day does not end progress
brief.hook: Missed yesterday? Come back today and keep your streak
brief.key_message: Your phone keeps your streak alive if you miss a day — open the app and do your 10-minute session at home.

tests.name: Busy Week Starter - Testimonial Learn
tests.hypothesis: Testimonial won the week at $2.4 per trial, testing a busy-week starter message on phone will show if a low-pressure routine can keep costs near target
tests.stop_rule: Run 7 days, read out vs $4 target

brief.angle: Busy-week starter on phone - three short sessions to stay consistent
brief.hook: Busy week? Start with three short sessions
brief.key_message: Use your phone to fit in three short sessions this week at home, no gear needed.

tests.name: Home No Gear Trial
tests.hypothesis: High Streak cost suggests the 10-minute no-gear at-home benefit is not landing, testing that clear product benefit on phone will lower cost toward target
tests.stop_rule: Run 7 days, keep winner vs target

brief.angle: No-gear 10 minutes at home on phone
brief.hook: 10 minutes at home, no gear - try a free session today
brief.key_message: Open your phone and try a 10-minute home workout with no gear, start your free trial.

evidence.note: Streak (ad_1): CTR on day 7 vs its first day (day 1).
